To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(a) disability is associated with poverty; (b) the relationship is stronger when using the WHO disability assessment schedule (DAS); and (c) the relationship is strongest for the poorest households.
The prevalence of disability is high in the study area, and that the prevalence of disability is higher among the poorest households than among the wealthiest households.
disability severity is a significant predictor of poverty and that disability measures can be used as a proxy indicator of poverty in the context of Viet Nam.
